david (sec-eng): Heads up: npm audit found a high in yargs-parser pulled in via esbuild-runner -> @org/cli-utils. Looks like the old prototype-pollution advisory affecting parsing logic.

anya (frontend): Ugh... which package exactly? Is it a direct dep of console-ui?

david (sec-eng): Not direct. audit snippet:
```
# npm audit report
yargs-parser  < 18.1.3
Severity: high
Prototype pollution -> unsafe parsing of flags
Path: console-ui > esbuild-runner > @org/cli-utils > yargs-parser\```

mike (platform): pinging CI: does our build use esbuild-runner in prod bundles or only as a dev-time helper?

anya (frontend): esbuild-runner is dev-only for `npm start` and local scripts, but some transitive deps are picked up in CI build steps. Risk is mainly supply-chain / dev-run exposure.

raj (sec-eng): Initial triage: exploitability to end-users looks low, but supply-chain risk is non-trivial. Recommend patching transitive dep ASAP and hard-failing high sev in CI.

ci-bot: Build scan: 1 high severity (yargs-parser <18.1.3) detected in console-ui. See https://npmjs.com/advisories/XXXX

mike (platform): Suggested remediation options: 
- Add package.json "overrides" to pin yargs-parser@18.1.3 (minimal churn)
- Upgrade esbuild-runner / @org/cli-utils if upstream releases a fix (preferred upstream)
- Run `npm audit fix` and verify lockfile changes
Which route do we take? We care about limiting lockfile churn and risk in release branches.

anya (frontend): I prefer overrides so we can push a small change and test quickly. We should run full UI e2e afterwards.

david (sec-eng): Agreed on overrides as a quick mitigation. Also prepare a ticket to follow upstream fixes so we can remove the override later. Add a note to SECURITY docs.

mike (platform): I'll draft the PR with an overrides entry: 
```json
"overrides": {
  "yargs-parser": "18.1.3"
}
```
And CI step: `npm ci && npm audit --audit-level=high` to fail the job if any high sev remains.

deploy-bot: PR #5289 opened by mike: "chore(ui): pin yargs-parser@18.1.3 via overrides"

anya (frontend): Running local build + storybook smoke now. So far no regressions.

raj (sec-eng): After merge, plan: patch release, backport to v1.x branch, and add a short postmortem note on detection and mitigation timeline. Also add a rule to our scanning config to catch yargs-parser <18.1.3 earlier.

david (sec-eng): Please also add a line in SECURITY/DEPENDENCIES.md describing why we used overrides and the intended removal condition (upstream release or major dep bump).

mike (platform): Timeline: PR today, canary tomorrow morning, patch release if canary passes and no regressions. I'll tag @release-captain once CI green.

anya (frontend): Thanks all — will monitor canary and log any UI anomalies. :thumbsup:

raj (sec-eng): Thanks team. Good quick coord. :white_check_mark:
